elements.title: Decision tree with max depth of 2
elements.details: The diagram is a decision tree with nodes labeled by feature names and split conditions (unreadable). The tree has a root node branching into two child nodes, each further branching into leaf nodes. Leaf nodes show the number of samples and class distribution (unreadable). The tree is colored (filled=True) to indicate class or purity. The tree depth is limited to 2 levels.
elements.summary: This decision tree diagram illustrates a model limited to a maximum depth of 2 to reduce overfitting, showing how the data is split at each node and the distribution of samples in leaf nodes.
